task_summary: Implement clamp in solution.py and add standard-library unittest coverage in test_solution.py for ordinary, boundary, and empty inputs, or invalid numeric inputs if no collection is accepted.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Clamp values into the inclusive [low, high] range; raise ValueError when low > high; equal bounds are valid.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
Add at least two passing unittest methods that exercise the public API.

success_criteria.description: solution.py defines a typed public clamp function.
test_solution.py contains at least two unittest test methods.

check.command: python -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; tree=ast.parse(Path("test_solution.py").read_text()); assert sum(isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith("test") for c in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(c, ast.ClassDef) for n in c.body) >= 2'

success_criteria.description: The unittest suite passes under the requested discovery command.
The implementation and test module compile successfully.

assumptions: The named files are relative to the supplied task workspace; solution.py and test_solution.py may not exist yet and may be created.

The request does not specify clamp's parameter names, accepted input types, or exact public API beyond its clamp behavior; implementation and tests should use a reasonable typed API and exercise it consistently.

The request says empty inputs or invalid numeric inputs when no collection is accepted; assume clamp accepts individual numeric values, so tests should include invalid numeric inputs unless the implementation's public API accepts collections.
